# About

## PhD Student in AI-Driven Forecasting for Health Equity

I am a PhD student at the **Data Lab for Social Good** at **Cardiff University**. My research project, **“Reducing Health Screening Inequalities in Wales: AI-Driven Forecasting,”** focuses on developing data-driven methods to support fairer and more effective preventive health screening services in Wales.

My research combines **artificial intelligence, forecasting, fairness-aware machine learning, and simulation** to identify inequalities in screening uptake and support better healthcare planning.

I am particularly interested in building practical and transparent tools that can help health services allocate resources more fairly and improve access to preventive screening across communities in Wales.

Explore my [full list of publications](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=FhUWJo4AAAAJ) on Google Scholar.
